# Full-dataset results (all PhysioNet 2019 training stays)

*Generated by `scripts/make_full_report.py` from `public/full/*.json`. Same pipeline, features, split method, seeds and hyper-parameters as the first run; only the amount of data differs.*

The first run used 14,635 stays (175 septic in its test split), about 37% of the data (the PhysioNet server throttles downloads). This run uses **39,317 stays** (504 septic in the test split of 7,864).

| | First run (37% sample) | **Full dataset** |
|---|---|---|
| Stays (train / calibration / test) | 8,781 / 2,927 / 2,927 | 23,590 / 7,863 / 7,864 |
| Septic stays in test | 175 | 504 |
| **AuraZ-R AUROC (95% CI)** | 0.819 (0.791–0.845) | **0.831** (0.815–0.846) |
| AUPRC | 0.077 | 0.061 |
| Without ICU-time features | 0.794 | 0.820 |
| Without ICU-time and recency features | 0.766 | 0.783 |
| Same features, logistic regression | 0.765 | 0.782 |
| Conformal coverage, septic · non-septic (target 90%) | 86% · 91% | 91% · 89% |
| Septic caught, low-burden setting (budget 15) | 57% at 15.0 false alerts/100 patient-days | 62% at 17.5 |
| Septic caught at SIRS's alarm rate (SIRS: first / full) | 95% (SIRS 89%) | 96% (SIRS 87%) |

## External validation (train on one hospital, test on the other)

| Train → test | First run: test septic · AUROC | Full dataset: test septic · AUROC (95% CI) | Full coverage septic · non-septic |
|---|---|---|---|
| A → B | 329 · 0.737 | 888 · **0.787** (0.772–0.800) | 74% · 91% |
| B → A | 590 · 0.745 | 1527 · **0.771** (0.761–0.782) | 93% · 78% |
| Pooled random split (reference) | 175 · 0.819 | 504 · 0.831 (0.816–0.847) | |

## Subgroups, full dataset (same alert threshold for every group)

alert if risk >= 0.0525 (top 5% of all held-out patient-hours)

| Subgroup | Septic stays | AUROC | Alert rate | Septic hours alerted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| sex=female | 205 | 0.833 | 4.7% | 38% |
| sex=male | 299 | 0.830 | 5.2% | 32% |
| age<50 | 110 | 0.836 | 4.1% | 27% |
| age 50-64 | 167 | 0.816 | 6.4% | 38% |
| age 65-74 | 116 | 0.854 | 4.6% | 38% |
| age>=75 | 111 | 0.826 | 4.4% | 33% |

## Reading it
- Pooled AUROC moved from 0.819 to 0.831 (+0.012); the confidence interval width went from 0.054 to 0.031.
- Across hospitals: A → B 0.787, B → A 0.771.
- All numbers here come from a retrospective, two-hospital dataset; this is research evidence, not clinical validation.
